construction_decision.reason: The single feature has a constant closed circular section and needs one capped body; one supplied valid profile and one distance meet the extrusion prerequisites. No second section or loft binding is supplied.
prerequisites: SpaceClaim 2022 R1 with V21 scripting API and IronPython 2.7, as supplied.
Caller-supplied valid closed planar circular profile of radius 0.007 m.
construction_decision.covered_effect: Create one capped Modeler Body representing the diameter-14 mm, length-9 mm constant circular material addition; no attachment or union to any other body.
construction_decision.stability_basis: Simpler available method for this constant-section feature, with supplied version-associated signature facts. This is documented planning support, not measured reliability or live runtime compatibility.

alternative_conditions.when_preferred: If the requested feature instead has different sections and caller supplies at least two sections, matching rules and an appropriate version binding.
alternative_conditions.tradeoff: Adds section/matching prerequisites not present or necessary here; not currently eligible.

provenance.rationale: Filter the two explicitly supplied methods against this one feature's prerequisites and select extrusion; preserve supplied documentation-only evidence boundary.

argument_mappings.semantic_input: Caller-supplied valid closed planar circular profile, radius 0.007 m; not constructed by this binding.

return_mapping.boundary: No attachment/union to another body and no document insertion behavior inferred.

compatibility_notes: Exact symbol, parameter order/types and return semantics are bound to the supplied V21 signature transcription; installed API documents were not independently read by this evaluator.
Target host/release/runtime are caller-supplied. No API call, model construction, document insertion, attachment/union or runtime compatibility test was performed.
A valid profile is explicitly supplied; the separate CircleProfile signature is not invoked or bundled into this single-action binding.

provenance.rationale: Bind exactly the supplied ExtrudeProfile signature to the supplied profile and 0.009 m distance; no invented overload or additional operation.
State limits of transcribed source evidence and distinguish the unused profile constructor from the requested single binding.

criteria.expected: newly created body supplied as selection scope

semantic_predicate.match_rule: Within the supplied new body's faces, require every criterion. This defines a candidate test only; accept selection only when exactly one face matches. Expected values are analytic inputs, not measured properties.

ambiguity_policy.zero_matches: Stop; report no qualifying positive-end cap and inspect geometry/measurement input. Do not substitute an index.
ambiguity_policy.one_match: Permit that candidate only after every criterion is measured and satisfied; no live candidate is selected by this declaration.
ambiguity_policy.multiple_matches: Stop; report candidates and require distinguishing geometry evidence. Do not select by index or creation order.

provenance.rationale: Use caller's planar end position, outward normal, area and individual tolerances. No intervening topology change or old handle exists, so optional refresh prerequisite is not required and no MS-07 declaration is synthesized.

measurement_method.evidence_layer: Caller-supplied kernel-volume measurement interface contract; implementation untested and no measurement performed.

assertion_definition.pass_rule: Only a finite measured value V from the supplied adapter can pass, and only if abs(V - 1385.4423602330984) <= 0.01 mm^3.
assertion_definition.fail_rule: For an available finite measured value V, fail if abs(V - 1385.4423602330984) > 0.01 mm^3. Do not mutate geometry to satisfy the check.
assertion_definition.unknown_measurement_rule: Unavailable result, adapter failure or non-finite value means unknown/unverified and must not pass; report missing measurement evidence.

provenance.rationale: Bind one supplied expected volume to the supplied adapter interface, unit, absolute tolerance and unavailable-result boundary. This is an assertion definition, not an assertion result.
